newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse closes up, fresh highs seen.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse closes up, fresh highs seen.

text.p: Bucharest bourse first-tier listings closed up in a bullish mood amid fresh foreign interest in Romanian equities after the government approved rules for portfolio investments this week, traders said.
"Foreign investors' interest was boosted by the news on the portfolio investments decree, and was focused mainly on the first tier on Friday," one trader said.
He added the weaker leu currency in recent days had generated higher interest in bourse high-caps.
Operators forecast fresh highs for next week under healthy buying pressure.
Volume inched up to 3.5 million shares on Friday from the 3.2 million on the previous day, while turnover went up to 12.8 billion lei from 10.8 billion on Thursday.

Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, jumped by 3.8 and 9.02 percent respectively from the previous session. The BIG index reached a new year high at 1,037.79, while the BIG first-tier index was 4.91 percent up at 4,208.7 points.
A strong buying mood in all six first-tier listings pushed up their prices, traders said.
Chemical plant Oltchim and Azomures fertiliser maker closed 250 lei and 450 lei firmer at 3,100 and 3,750 respectively.
Three special deals involving over 351,000 shares were struck after closing in the first-tier chemical plant Oltchim.
Pharmaceuticals companies Antibiotice ATBE.BX and Terapia firmed 50 and 1,000 lei higher at 5,200 and 6,500.
Sofert fertiliser maker and refrigerator maker Arctic gained 1,000 and 50 lei respectively to close at 65,000 and 3,450.

Both stocks gained on Friday's close despite traders' forecasts which said refrigerator maker Arctic was too new for investors and Sofert too expensive to post gains. Operators were unwilling to forecast future trends for either listing.
On the second-tier, Policolor dye maker stayed at center-stage with over 290,000 shares traded. Policolor closed 200 lei up to 5,700.
